description: Local proxy that intercepts real DeepSeek requests and shows today's cost and token usage in the status bar (Beijing time).
config.statusBarFormat: Status bar display format: full (cost + tokens), cost, or tokens.
config.title: DeepSeek Usage
config.autoStart: Automatically start the proxy when VS Code launches.
config.manageBaseUrl: Point deepseek-copilot.baseUrl at the local proxy while running, and restore it when stopped.
config.language: UI language. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language; 'en'/'zh-cn' force a language (default 'en').
